description: This Java source file defines an Android Wear OS watch face service, specifically an interactive watch face that responds to tap events, counts different tap-related commands, and displays the counts and touch coordinates on the watch face.

classes.name: InteractiveWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main class extending CanvasWatchFaceService, providing the watch face engine.

classes.name: InteractiveWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handling rendering, tap event processing, and watch face updates.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Engine that contains the watch face logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the engine, sets WatchFaceStyle, and initializes painting tools and counters.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout parameters for round or square screens and sets text size accordingly.

methods.name: onPeekCardPositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates the position of the peek card overlay.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in device properties like low-bit ambient mode and burn-in protection.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Handles toggling between ambient and interactive modes, adjusts paint anti-aliasing.

methods.name: onTapCommand
methods.description: Handles tap events, increments counters based on tap type, updates display.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws background, tap counts, touch coordinates, and peek card overlay.
